title: Recover your account
login-link: Lost your passkeys? Recover your account
explain: Enter your recovery code. You then create a new passkey and receive a new recovery code that replaces the old one.
code.label: Recovery code
unknown: No account was found for this recovery code. Check the code.
rate-limited: Too many recovery attempts. Try again in {time}.
rate-limited.later: Too many recovery attempts. Try again later.
lost: Without passkeys and without the recovery code your identity cannot be restored: an admin of your organization can remove you and invite you again.
passkey.title: Create a new passkey
passkey.explain: Your recovery code is correct. Your device will now ask you to create a new passkey.
passkey.cancelled: Passkey creation was cancelled – try again.
unlock.title: Sign in with the new passkey
unlock.explain: Confirm once more with the new passkey to sign in.
unlock.other-account: Another passkey answered. Sign in with the passkey you just created.
new-code: This new recovery code has replaced your old one. Store it in a safe place and confirm it.
save-failed: The new recovery code could not be saved: {reason}
